clips.title: The story
paras: At Jordan Stilwell’s forge, Jordan's Smithing Hammer carries a family legacy into his work. His father passed it down to him, and its recovery from Shadowfang Keep is needed for a weapon consecrated to the Light.

Jordan Stilwell keeps his father’s hammer close, for it carries his family’s craft and his hopes for a masterwork. The human blacksmith works outside Ironforge, but the heirloom has somehow ended up in Shadowfang Keep, within the stone walls of Silverpine Forest. Jordan needs it back before he can forge a sacred weapon fit for a holy champion.
